name: Gomamon Trainer
source:
Gomamon Trainer is a work-in-progress visual novel digimon smut game which pushes you into a strange digital world, trapped with a cute male Gomamon. The very same Gomamon from Digimon Adventure.

[From [url=https://towan-games-studio.itch.io/gomamon-trainer]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Gomamon Trainer》是一款仍在开发中的《数码宝贝》成人同人视觉小说。你被卷入一个陌生的数码世界，与一只可爱的雄性哥玛兽一同受困于此。没错，就是《数码宝贝大冒险》里的那只哥玛兽。

[摘自[url=https://towan-games-studio.itch.io/gomamon-trainer]Itch.io[/url]]
